notes: BUU v3.1.3 - Fieldwork scraper now waits for cancellations to finish loading. The Service History page loads its cancellations a moment AFTER the page appears; the scraper was reading the page too early and missing them (only 25 of ~1289 locations returned last run). It now waits for the cancellation data to settle on each location before reading, so every cancellation is captured. Re-run your NOTHING FOUND list to pick up everything that was missed.
